control_00002 - Domain PASS Low The 'ip domain name' command in the running configuration.
control_00003 - AAA PASS High All 'aaa' commands in the running configuration.
control_00004 - TACACS FAIL High 'tacacs server ACME_TACACS_01': address '192.168.100.100' does not match the corporate TACACS server address '192.168.100.101'.; 'tacacs server ACME_TACACS_02': address '192.168.100.101' does not match the corporate TACACS server address '192.168.100.102'.

control_00009 - NTP FAIL Medium 'ntp server 10.10.10.100 prefer': missing a 'key <id>' reference to the NTP authentication key.; 'ntp server 20.20.20.100': missing a 'key <id>' reference to the NTP authentication key.
Remediation: Configure at least two reliable NTP servers, use the 'prefer' keyword for the primary source, and enable NTP authentication.
control_00010 - Syslog PASS Medium 'logging' commands in the running configuration.
control_00011 - SNMP PASS High 'snmp-server' configuration lines and 'show snmp user' output.
control_00012 - Banners FAIL Medium 'banner motd' opening delimiter '$' has no matching closing '$' - the banner is malformed/incomplete.

control_00013 - Passwords PASS High 'security passwords min-length' and 'service password-encryption' commands.
